label: Scene Template: Screencast Showcase
description: WHOLE-SCENE template for scenes whose star is a REAL screen recording. Lit atmosphere background, small-caps kicker, the footage presented in a polished macos-browser frame (crop:'auto' removes the recording's own window chrome via ingest analysis), and timed caption chips in a reserved bottom band. Use for ANY screencast/screen-recording scene -- raw footage on a bare canvas is a composition failure. Instantiation adds the screencast-frame component automatically; give this template the footage URL as 'source'.

captions.label: Array of {at, text}: caption chips timed in scene seconds
